x-e-e6-04.title: Samaynta jadwallo si loo helo kiisaska sheegashadu run tahay
x-e-e6-04.goal: Adigu samee dhowr jadwal codbixin oo sheegashada Ingiriisiga ah 'it got the most votes, but not half of the class' ay run tahay.
x-e-e6-04.material: 20 arday oo fasalka ah mid kasta wuxuu dhiibtay hal cod hawsha kadib wakhtiga cuntada fudud: kubadda cagta, farshaxanka, ama muusiga. Codadka waxaa loo yeedhaa s (kubadda cagta), a (farshaxanka), iyo m (muusiga).
x-e-e6-04.thinking.0: Kala saarista 'ugu badan' iyo 'ka badan badh'
x-e-e6-04.thinking.1: Samaynta tusaalayaal buuxinaya dhowr shuruudood isla markaa
x-e-e6-04.s.s1.prompt: Natiijadu waxay ahayd kubadda cagta 8 cod, farshaxanka 6 cod, muusiga 6 cod. Weedhee ayaa si ugu sax ah u sharxaysa?
x-e-e6-04.s.s1.hint.0: Isku dar 8, 6, iyo 6, hel waxa badhka 20-ka arday yahay, oo barbar dhig.
x-e-e6-04.s.s1.hint.1: Barbar dhig waxa 'most' iyo 'everyone' mid kasta sheegaan.
x-e-e6-04.s.s1.r.a: Hubi haddii labada shuruudoodba lagu xaqiijiyay tirooyin.
x-e-e6-04.s.s1.r.b: Tani waxay 'ugu badnaanta' u fidisay 'qof walba'.
x-e-e6-04.s.s1.r.c: Mar kale barbar dhig haddii 8 uu ka weyn yahay ama ka yar yahay 10.
x-e-e6-04.s.s1.explain: 8 cod waa ka badan yihiin farshaxanka (6) iyo muusiga (6), sidaas darteed waa ugu badnaan, wuxuuna ka yar yahay 10, badhka 20, sidaas darteed ma aha badh. Sidaas darteed a waa sax.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.prompt: Samee 3 jadwal codbixin oo kala duwan oo wadarta ardaydu tahay 20 oo isla sheegashada ('soccer got the most votes, but not half') ay run tahay.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.hint.0: Kubadda cagta waa inay yeelataa ugu badnaan, sidaas darteed ka bilow doorashada qiime ka weyn farshaxanka iyo muusiga.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.hint.1: Hagaaji kubadda cagta hal qiime, kadibna ka jar 20 oo inta hadhay u qaybi farshaxanka iyo muusiga. Haddii kubadda cagta ay aad u yar tahay, ma gaari kartid 20.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.ok.c1: Codadku waa tirooyin dhan oo ah 0 ama ka badan.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Codadka u qor tirooyin dhan oo ah 0 ama ka badan.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.ok.c3: Kubadda cagta waxay leedahay ugu badnaan.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.fail.c3: Kubadda cagta ma leh wax ka badan farshaxanka ama muusiga.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.ok.c4: Kubadda cagta waxay ka hooseysaa badh (10 cod).
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.fail.c4: Kubadda cagta waa ugu yaraan badh (10 cod).
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.explain: Si kubadda cagta u yeelato ugu badnaan, farshaxanka iyo muusigu mid kasta waa inuu ka yaraado s, wadartoodana waa 20-s. Haddii s=7, markaas a+m=13, sidaas darteed labaduba ma noqon karaan 6 ama ka yar, sidaas darteed way fashilantaa, haddii s uu yahay 10 ama ka badan-na waa badh. Sidaas darteed s waxay noqon kartaa 8 ama 9 oo keliya.

x-e-e6-01.title: Kala saarista sababaha loo hayo xayawaan fasalka
x-e-e6-01.goal: Qoraalka fikirka Jin, kala sooc fikirka lafteeda, sababaha, tusaalayaasha u adeega sidii caddayn, iyo hadalada mawduuca ka baxsan, ka dibna go'aami Ingiriisi sabab kee ayaa ugu xooggan.
x-e-e6-01.material:
Fasalka 6-3 ayaa ka hadlaya "Ma waa inaan haysano xayawaan fasalka?" Waa kan qoraalka Jin.

I think we should get a class pet. A pet can teach us to take care of animals. I like cats very much, and I want to see one every day. Class 6-1 had a fish last year, and students fed it by turns. Also, many students are afraid of dogs.
x-e-e6-01.thinking.0: Kala saarista fikir iyo sababaha taageera
x-e-e6-01.thinking.1: Kala saarista dhadhan shakhsi ah iyo caddayn la hubin karo
x-e-e6-01.thinking.2: Is barbar dhigidda sida xooggan sababuhu yihiin
x-e-e6-01.prereq.0: Waad akhrin kartaa erayada fikirka sida I think ~ / because
x-e-e6-01.prereq.1: Erayo fudud sida fish, pet, feed
x-e-e6-01.s.s1.prompt: Dooro weedh kasta oo sabab u ah taageerada fikirka Jin 'waa inaan helno xayawaan fasalka'.
x-e-e6-01.s.s1.hint.0: Weedh kasta, is weydii haddii ay caawinayso sheegashada ah in fasalka oo dhan uu haysto xayawaan.
x-e-e6-01.s.s1.hint.1: Kala sooc weedhaha muujinaya dareenka hadlaha oo keliya, sida 'I like ...', iyo xaqiiqooyinka dadka kale hubin karaan.
x-e-e6-01.s.s1.r.a: Weedhdan waxay ka hadlaysaa faa'iido fasalka. Sidoo kale is barbar dhig fikirka: ma waa isla shay mar kale la yiri?
x-e-e6-01.s.s1.r.b: Ka fikir haddii dhadhanka shakhsi ee hadlaha uu yahay sabab fasalka oo dhan.
x-e-e6-01.s.s1.r.c: Weedhdan waxay isticmaashaa wax runtii dhacay sidii tusaale. Ka fikir sida ay ugu xiran tahay sheegashada.
x-e-e6-01.s.s1.r.d: Go'aami haddii tani tahay sabab loo haysto xayawaan guud ahaan, mise walwal ku saabsan xayawaan qaar oo keliya.
x-e-e6-01.s.s1.r.e: Eeg haddii weedhdan ay tahay sabab ama sheegashada lafteeda.
x-e-e6-01.s.s1.explain: a waa sabab magacaabaysa faa'iido haysashada xayawaan, c-na waa caddayn sababtoo ah waa tusaale fasal kale runtii isku dayay. b waa dhadhanka shakhsiga Jin oo keliya, ma aha sabab fasalku u baahan yahay, d runtii wuxuu ka soo horjeedaa xayawaan qaar, e-na ma aha sabab laakiin waa sheegashada lafteeda.
x-e-e6-01.s.s2.prompt: Qor hal ama laba weedhood Ingiriisi ah Jin. Sheeg sababaha Jin kee ayaa ugu xooggan, oo bixi sharaxaaddaada (ama sheeg waxa dheeraad ah ee loo baahan yahay).
x-e-e6-01.s.s2.hint.0: Dooro hal sabab xooggan oo weedhaas ka qaado hal ama laba eray si aad ugu isticmaasho jawaabtaada.
x-e-e6-01.s.s2.hint.1: Isticmaal because ama so si aad ugu xirto 'sababta ay u xoog badan tahay'.
x-e-e6-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma sheegtay weedhda qoraalka Jin kee ayuu yahay sababta aad dooratay?
x-e-e6-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma sharaxday sababta sababtaas u xoog badan tahay (ama waxa dheeraad ah ee loo baahan yahay)?
x-e-e6-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma xukuntay sababaha fasalka oo dhan, ma aha dhadhankaaga? (ikhtiyaari)
x-e-e6-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Jawaab tilmaamtay daciifnimada sabab (tusaale ma laha).

x-e-e6-02.title: Saxidda qaybaha email macallin oo aan is waafaqsanayn
x-e-e6-02.goal: Hel halka labada sadar ee email-ka aysan is waafaqsanayn, oo dib u qor Ingiriisi si qorshuhu u shaqeeyo.
x-e-e6-02.material: Yuna waxay rabtaa inay email u dirto macallinkeeda, Mr. Park, ku saabsan kulan shaqada guriga sayniiska kooxeed. Maktabadda waa la isticmaali karaa ilaa 5 p.m. Khamiista.
x-e-e6-02.thinking.0: Helidda is-diidka u dhexeeya sadarrada email-ka
x-e-e6-02.thinking.1: Is barbar dhigidda hagaajinta suurtagalka ah: sadarkee la beddeli karaa
x-e-e6-02.thinking.2: Hubinta in weedhda la saxay ay ku habboon tahay sadarrada kale
x-e-e6-02.prereq.1: Erayo fudud sida can, want to, after
x-e-e6-02.s.s1.prompt: Dooro hal sadar email-kan ah oo aan ku habboonayn sadarrada kale, sidaas darteed kulanku ma shaqayn karo.
x-e-e6-02.s.s1.hint.0: Waqtiga kulanka ku dhig waqtiga xubin kooxda mid ka mid ah imaan karto oo is barbar dhig.
x-e-e6-02.s.s1.hint.1: Qor maalinta iyo waqtiga sadar kasta, oo ay ku jirto 'a.m./p.m.'.
x-e-e6-02.s.s1.explain: Sadarka 3 wuxuu weydiisanayaa kulan 3 p.m. Khamiista, sadarka 4-na wuxuu leeyahay Mina imaan karto 4 p.m. ka dib oo keliya, sidaas darteed labada sadar isma waafaqsana. Waxaad saxi kartaa waqtiga kulanka (sadarka 3) ama beddeli kartaa xaaladda Mina (sadarka 4), sidaas darteed waxaan aqbalnaa sadar kasta oo aad dooratid.
x-e-e6-02.s.s2.prompt: Dib u qor sadarka 3 Ingiriisi si kulanku u shaqeeyo. Waa inaad sidoo kale xusuusataa in maktabadda la isticmaali karo ilaa 5 p.m. oo keliya.
x-e-e6-02.s.s2.hint.0: Dooro waqti kulan oo u dhexeeya waqtiga ugu horreeya ee Mina imaan karto iyo waqtiga maktabaddu xidhmayso.
x-e-e6-02.s.s2.hint.1: Waxaad sidoo kale beddeli kartaa maalinta halkii waqtiga. Haddii aad sidaas samayso, hubi in sadarka 4 sidoo kale wali ku habboon yahay.
x-e-e6-02.s.s2.placeholder: Tusaale: Our group wants to meet...
x-e-e6-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Waqtiga aad saxday ma ka dambeeyaa waqtiga Mina imaan karto (ama ma beddeshay maalinta)?
x-e-e6-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Weedhdii la saxay ma ku habboon tahay labadaba xeerka 5 p.m. ee maktabadda iyo sadarka 4?
x-e-e6-02.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Weedhdii la saxay ma si dabiici ah ayay ula xiriirtaa sadarrada kale ee email-ka?
x-e-e6-02.s.s2.modelNote.1: Jawaab beddelatay maalinta oo sidoo kale ka dhigtay sadarka sababta mid ku habboon.

x-e-e6-05.title: Hal dhalig qoyan miyuu noo sheegi karaa 'hadda waa roob'?
x-e-e6-05.topic: Male-awaal qarsoon oo ku jira sheegasho fudud
x-e-e6-05.goal: Hel male-awaalka sababaynta gaaban ee Mia ay rumaysan tahay iyadoon sheegin, oo Ingiriis ku samee xaalad male-awaalkaasi khaldan yahay.
x-e-e6-05.material: Mia waxay tidhi, "Dan wuxuu galay qolka fasalka isagoo wata dhalig qoyan. Sidaas darteed hadda waa roob dibadda."
x-e-e6-05.thinking.1: Samaynta xaalad tusaale ka soo horjeedda halka male-awaalku jabo
x-e-e6-05.thinking.2: Sheegidda shuruudaha hoostooda sheegashadu sii jirto
x-e-e6-05.prereq.0: Erayada fudud sida wet, rain, outside
x-e-e6-05.prereq.1: Waxaad akhrin kartaa sababaha ku xidhan because/so
x-e-e6-05.s.s1.prompt: Waa maxay fikirka Mia aysan sheegin, laakiin ay tahay inay rumaysan tahay, si 'hadda waa roob dibadda' uga soo baxdo?
x-e-e6-05.s.s1.hint.0: Gabagabada Mia dib ugu noqo hal tallaabo mar kasta oo arag waxa loo baahan yahay si 'dhaligu waa qoyan' u noqdo 'hadda waa roob'.
x-e-e6-05.s.s1.hint.1: Kala saar xaqiiqooyinka horay qoraalka ugu qoran iyo rumaysadyada aan qorin.
x-e-e6-05.s.s1.r.a: Tani waa xaqiiqo horay qoraalka ugu jirta. Hubi haddii ay tahay fikir qarsoon.
x-e-e6-05.s.s1.r.b: Tani waa isticmaal guud oo dhaligyada. Ka fikir haddii ay tahay isku xidhka sababayntani runtii u baahan tahay.
x-e-e6-05.s.s1.r.c: Tani waxay ka hadlaysaa buundada ka gudubta 'qoyan' ilaa 'hadda roob'.
x-e-e6-05.s.s1.r.d: Tani waa muuqaal horay qoraalka ugu qoran.
x-e-e6-05.s.s1.explain: Si loo yidhaahdo dhaligu waa qoyan sababtoo ah roob hadda, waxaad u baahan tahay male-awaalka ah sabab kale ma jirto. Dhaligu wuu qoyan karaa xitaa haddii roobku horay u istaagay, haddii dhaligii la dhaqay, ama haddii uu biyo ku dhacay.
x-e-e6-05.s.s2.prompt: Hal weedh Ingiriis ah ku qor xaalad gabagabada Mia ay khaldan tahay. Sheeg sababta dhaligu u qoyan yahay laakiin hadda roob ma aha.
x-e-e6-05.s.s2.hint.0: Ka fikir waxyaabo ka duwan roobka ka dhigaya dhalig qoyan. (biyo, waqti, goob)
x-e-e6-05.s.s2.hint.1: Xaalad waqti kale leh sidoo kale waa suurtagal, sida 'The rain has already stopped.'
x-e-e6-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Xaaladda aad qortay, ma dhaligu waa qoyan yahay laakiin hadda roob ma aha?
x-e-e6-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma arki kartaa sababta rumaysadka Mia (sabab kale ma jirto) uu khaldan yahay?

x-e-e6-07.title: Qorista jawaab si edeb leh u diida casuumaadda dhalashada saaxiib
x-e-e6-07.goal: Kala soo saar qaybaha jawaab diidaysa casuumaad ay u baahan tahay (mahadnaq, diidmo cad, sabab, beddel), oo adigu ku qor Ingiriis.
x-e-e6-07.material:
Saaxiibkaa Sam wuxuu diray farriin.

Hi! Can you come to my birthday party on Saturday at 2 p.m.? It is at my house. Please tell me by Wednesday.

Laakiin waxaad haysataa safar qoys Sabtida, sidaas darteed ma tegi kartid. Waa kan qabyo-qoraalkaaga ugu horreeya ee jawaabta: "I can't come to your party. Bye."
x-e-e6-07.thinking.0: Barbar dhigidda diidmo aan caddayn iyo diidmo cad
x-e-e6-07.thinking.1: Dooridda qaybaha daryeelaya dareenka qofka kale
x-e-e6-07.prereq.0: Muujinta sida can't / thank you for ~
x-e-e6-07.prereq.1: Erayada fudud sida Saturday, next week
x-e-e6-07.s.s1.prompt: Isbeddelladee ayaa caawin lahaa in qabyo-qoraalka kore loo beddelo jawaab ka wanaagsan oo diidaysa casuumaadda? Dooro dhammaan kuwa ku habboon.
x-e-e6-07.s.s1.hint.0: Sawir sida Sam u dareemi lahaa marka uu helo, oo raadi waxa qabyo-qoraalka ka maqan.
x-e-e6-07.s.s1.hint.1: Ka fikir sababta Sam u baahan yahay inuu helo jawaab ka hor Arbacada, oo barbar dhig macluumaadka doorasho kasta siiso Sam.
x-e-e6-07.s.s1.r.a: Ka fikir xaqiiqada ah Sam waa inuu go'aamiyo jawaab ka hor Arbacada.
x-e-e6-07.s.s1.r.b: Tani waa ficil marka hore aqoonsada dareenka qofka kale.
x-e-e6-07.s.s1.r.c: Barbar dhig sida qofka kale u dareemo marka sabab jirto iyo marka aan jirin.
x-e-e6-07.s.s1.r.d: Tani waa hab lagu ilaaliyo xidhiidhka kadib diidmada.
x-e-e6-07.s.s1.explain: Ka bilaabidda mahadnaq iyo soo jeedinta maalin kale waxay ka dhigtaa diidmada mid aan qabow ahayn. 'Maybe' wuxuu adkeeyaa in Sam qorshe sameeyo, ka tagidda sababta-na waxay u muuqan kartaa daryeel la'aan.
x-e-e6-07.s.s2.prompt: Qor jawaab Sam laba ama saddex weedh Ingiriis ah. Ku dar mahadnaq, diidmo cad (sabab leh), iyo soo jeedin kale. Sababtu looma baahna inay noqoto safarka qoyska.
x-e-e6-07.s.s2.hint.0: Hal weedh mid kasta u qor kala horreyntan: mahadnaq, sheegidda inaadan tegi karin, soo jeedin.
x-e-e6-07.s.s2.hint.1: Isticmaal eray cad sida can't / cannot diidmada, oo sababta ku xidh because ama so.
x-e-e6-07.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma ka kooban tahay mahadnaq, diidmo cad, sabab, iyo soo jeedin?
x-e-e6-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Kadib akhriska, Sam ma ogaan karaa si cad "ma tegi kartid"?
x-e-e6-07.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Codku ma yahay Ingiriis raaxo leh oo saaxiib ku habboon?
x-e-e6-07.s.s2.modelNote.1: Jawaab ku dhammaata soo jeedinta maalin kale.

x-e-e6-08.title: Weydiinta macallinka si edeb leh wakhtiga kama dambaysta ah ee shaqada guriga
x-e-e6-08.goal: Barbar dhig sida isla codsigu u dhawaaqo si kala duwan iyadoo ku xiran yaa dhegeysanaya, oo dib u qor sida codsi edeb leh macallinka.
x-e-e6-08.material: Waxaan buka Isniinta iyo Talaadada, sidaas darteed ma samayn karin shaqada gurigayga. Waxaan rabaa inaan Ingiriis ku weydiiyo macallinkayga fasalka Ms. Lee, "Please let me turn it in by Friday." Sidoo kale, waxaan rabaa inaan amaahdo kubadda koleyga waqtiga nasashada, sidaas darteed waxaan samayn doonaa isla codsiga saaxiibkay Min iyo macallinka jimicsiga Mr. Han.
x-e-e6-08.thinking.0: Dooridda habka hadalka ku habboon dhegeystaha
x-e-e6-08.thinking.1: U beddelidda codsi aan fudud sida uu yahay codsi edeb leh oo sabab leh
x-e-e6-08.thinking.2: Hubinta qaybaha codsiga (cinwaan, muujinta codsiga, sabab)
x-e-e6-08.prereq.0: Can I / Could you ~? iyo please
x-e-e6-08.prereq.1: Xaqiiqada ah waxaad si kala duwan ugala hadashaa saaxiib iyo macallin
x-e-e6-08.s.s1.prompt: Kee ayaa ah codsiga ugu habboon ee loo diro Ms. Lee?

x-e-e6-08.s.s1.r.a: Xitaa haddii please jiro, eeg haddii qaabka weedhu yahay amar.
x-e-e6-08.s.s1.r.b: Waa ogeysiis, ma aha codsi. Eeg haddii uu yahay qaab daaya meel macallinku ogolaansho siiyo.
x-e-e6-08.s.s1.r.c: Hubi haddii uu leeyahay qaab ku hadal, muujin codsi, iyo sabab, dhammaantood wadajir.
x-e-e6-08.s.s1.r.d: Eeg haddii uu u hadlayo sida natiijadu horay u go'an tahay.
x-e-e6-08.s.s1.explain: Macallinka, waa inaad isticmaashaa qaab ku hadal, oo ay la socoto qaab weydiisanaya ogolaansho sida Could I ~?, iyo sabab gaaban. a waa qaabka amarka xitaa please, b waa ogeysiis halkii uu ahaan lahaa codsi, d-na wuxuu u hadlaa sida qofka kale uusan diidi karin.
x-e-e6-08.s.s2.prompt: Waxaad rabtaa inaad amaahatid kubadda koleyga waqtiga nasashada. U qor isla codsiga Ingiriis laba sadar. x-e-e6-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Sadarka macallinku ma leeyahay muujin codsi sida "Would you please ...?"
x-e-e6-08.s.s2.selfAssess.3: Sadarka macallinku ma bixiyaa sabab aad u rabto inaad amaahato?
